本项目至此经历了**三次自我推翻**（方向标注、tick 估计、陈旧报价），每次都把结论改写；
**最终候选必须同时过「单位一致 + 数据新鲜 + 成本覆盖 + 容量 + 事件级净 EV」五道闸门。**

### 3.1 ⚠️ 重大更正（2026-11-12 晚）：**RKLB 与 KORU 的“超额边际”是陈旧报价假象**

30 天 1h 全序列的**重复收盘价比例**（相邻桶 close 完全相同 = 该桶没有新成交，只是沿用上一笔打印）：

| 标的 | Lighter 侧重复率 | HL 侧重复率 | Lighter 30 天桶数 | 判定 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| RKLB | **31%** | 0% | 720 | ❌ 边际被高估 |
| KORU | **36%** | 0% | **189** | ❌ 边际被高估 + 样本不足 |
| MRVL | 4% | 1% | 720 | ✅ 干净 |
| EWY | 5% | 1% | 720 | ✅ 干净 |
| SOXL | 1% | 0% | 720 | ✅ 干净 |

→ **RKLB 的 +14.0 bps/轮是「Lighter 报价长时间不动、HL 独自移动」造成的机械回归**，
  不是可成交的回归；KORU 同理（且 30 天只有 189 个桶）。
→ **数据质量闸门必须前置**：矩阵现在输出 `repeat_close_pct_A/B`，>10% 即标 `stale_print_suspect` 并排除出 `tradable`。
→ **更正后的候选排序：MRVL (+5.5) ≈ EWY (+4.0) > SOXL (+2.7)**；RKLB 降级为「待清洗后再评估」。

⚠️ KORU / KIOXIA 的 +100~160 bps 捕获**不可信**：Lighter 侧成交极稀疏（K 线由零星打印生成），
「回归」多半是陈旧报价造成的机械假象；它们的 ±25bps 深度也最小（$2.5k~$41k）。
在拿到 fill 级 markout 之前，这两对**不得进候选池**，宁可相信深度好的 RKLB/MRVL/EWY/SOXL。

## 4. 规模敏感性（SOXL 实测，fade 方向：卖 Lighter + 买 HL）

`b*` 里用的是「2 tick 滑点」；按实际规模吃盘口后 `b*` 迅速上升：

| 单腿名义 | 实际滑点（两腿合计） | 该规模 b* | 扣成本净 |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| $100 | 2.9 bps | 13.0 | **+4.1** |
| $500 | 5.7 | 15.7 | **+1.3** |
| $1000 | 9.4 | 19.4 | −2.4 |
| $5000 | 24.9 | 35.0 | −17.9 |
| $10000 | 32.4 | 42.5 | −25.4 |

**盘口给的 $19k 是账面容量，不是可交易容量**；SOXL 的真实可执行规模是 **$100–500/腿**。
→ 选票时必须把「按目标规模吃盘口后的滑点」写进 `b*`，不能只用 tick 估算。

## 5. 会话分层（用户关心的核心问题）

- **流动好的标的（NVDA/INTC/SNDK/MSTR/CRCL）在 RTH 与 closed 都没有净收益**——它们不是回归标的。
- **RKLB 在 RTH 与 closed 都为正**（+14.3/+18.3）→ 会话不敏感，最稳；
  **EWY**（+6.3/+7.7）次之；**MRVL 只在 RTH 为正**（+12.6 vs 0.0）；**SOXL 只在 closed 为正**（+7.7 vs −1.5）。
- **MRVL 只在 RTH 为正**（+10.5 vs −1.5）；**SOXL 只在 closed 为正**（+5.7 vs −3.2）
  → 「避开美股盘中」这条规则**只对部分标的有效**，必须逐对判断，不能一刀切。
- 2026 年美股会话按 NYSE 日历标定（含 9 个假日、2 个提前收盘日、DST 切换），实现见
  `src/nt_pairs/sessions.py`（7 个测试）。

## 5. 当前裁决

1. **可做候选（按稳健度）**：RKLB > MRVL ≈ EWY > SOXL。
   前三者净 +4~+12 bps/轮、中位持仓 3~5 分钟、容量 $3k~$27k。
2. **必须先证伪的假象**：97% 胜率（SOXL）说明捕获来自**报价层面的快速回归**，
   真实可成交性取决于「我们挂在 Lighter 侧能不能被成交」与「成交时是不是逆向选择」。
   → 需要用 L2 回放或实盘 fill 日志标定 `p_fill` 与 markout。
3. **不做**：NVDA / INTC / SNDK / MSTR / CRCL（基差覆盖不了成本）、KIOXIA / IREN（无容量）、
   ANT / OPENAI（单位口径不同，除非做单位校准器）。

## 5.5 换腿结论（2026-11-12 晚，OKX 腿实测）

用同一套 fade 规则，把对腿从 Lighter 换成 **OKX**（30 天 1h，134~180 个事件/标的）：

| 标的 | b*（含 OKX 费） | Capture | **净 EV** | 胜率 | OKX 点差 | OKX ±25bps 深度 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SOXL | 20.1 | +11.0 | **−9.1** | 100% | 1.68 | $895,147 |
| RKLB | 20.6 | +13.3 | **−7.3** | 100% | 3.13 | $46,747 |
| MRVL | 17.3 | +8.5 | **−8.8** | 100% | 0.63 | $103,285 |
| EWY | 16.9 | +7.3 | **−9.6** | 100% | 0.70 | $264,064 |
| INTC | 19.7 | +6.8 | **−13.0** | 100% | 1.67 | $352,708 |
| NVDA | 16.3 | +4.6 | **−11.7** | 95% | 0.64 | $588,311 |
| SNDK | 15.5 | +6.0 | **−9.5** | 100% | 1.11 | $1,492,867 |
| MSTR | 17.1 | +10.4 | **−6.7** | 100% | 0.87 | $531,334 |

**核心结论（推翻了「谁深谁做 taker」）：**
1. **胜率依然 95~100%，但净期望全负** → 回归是真的，**是费率把它吃掉**：
   OKX 腿 maker 2 + taker 5 = **7 bps**，HL 腿 6 bps，两腿合计 13 bps 的固定费，
   而 Capture 只有 4.6~13.3 bps。
2. **Lighter 的零费率是这套策略的隐性支柱**：它同时提供了「零费 taker 腿」和「可挂单的 maker 腿」。
   把对腿换成 OKX/Binance 之前，必须重算 `b*`，否则会把正期望做成负期望。
3. **OKX 腿的基差反而更「正常」**：均值 +14.8~+17.1 bps、sd 3.7~7.9、**ρ 0.22~0.72**
   （Lighter 腿 ρ=0.89）——更低自相关 = 更快回归，但幅度更小。

**顺带的行情事实**：`io:OAI ↔ LIGHTER OPENAI` 的溢价从 11-11 的 +305 bps 掉到 11-12 22:0x 的 **+32 bps**
→ 「结构性溢价不回归」只在那一段窗口成立；pre-IPO 溢价**会重定价**，这正是 `b_hat` 跳变 → HALT 的那条规则存在的原因。

## 6. 未完成 / 阻塞

| 项 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| OKX 多窗口统计 | 本机出口拦截（`www.okx.com` / `aws.okx.com` / `static.okx.com` 全 000），只有 2026-11-11 截面快照 |
| 多 agent 并行复核 | provider 配额耗尽（`429 insufficient_quota`，重置 12-07 16:00 UTC）；`--kind grok` 需人工登录 |
| `p_fill` / markout 标定 | 需要 L2 回放或实盘 fill 日志（尚无） |
| 2.0 runtime 节点启动 | Nautilus 2.0 移除了 `TradingNode`，需单独一轮 |

> 已从停点继续，矩阵 + SOXL 完整建模都跑完了。**先说两件必须知道的事**：① 本轮多 agent 在中途被**provider 配额打死**（`429 insufficient_quota`，重置 12-07 16:00 UTC），`--kind grok` 又卡在 x.ai 人工登录；② 本机直连 **OKX / Binance 被出口拦截**（`www.okx.com`、`aws.okx.com`、`fapi.binance.com` 全部 000），worker 沙箱同样不可达 —— 所以 OKX/Binance 只有 2026-11-11 的**截面**快照，多窗口矩阵实际覆盖 **HL ↔ Lighter**。剩下的全部由我本地脚本完成（可复现）。
>
> ## 1. 矩阵结果（30 对流动性最好的，30 天 1h + 会话分层 + 容量 + 单位校验）
> …（表格见 `docs/MATRIX_SUMMARY.md` §2.1）…
>
> ## 2. 事件级回放（5m，下一根 open 入场，扣真实成本；两次独立运行排序稳定）
> …（表格见 `docs/MATRIX_SUMMARY.md` §3）…
>
> ## 3. SOXL 完整建模（`docs/SOXL_SIM.md`）
> …（规模敏感性表见 `docs/SOXL_SIM.md` §5）…
>
> ## 4. 本轮抓到的两个自伤级错误（已修，已写进 field guide）
> 1. **方向标注**：我之前把「`z>0` 做多基差」叫成「回归」，那其实是**顺势**；顺势 −36 bps 等价于回归 **+36 bps**。修正后结论整个反转。
> 2. **tick 估计**：用「$100 以下 0.1」的经验规则，把 HL 2-tick 滑点高估 **10 倍**（32.7 vs 真实 0.33 bps）→ 现在一律**从盘口价位反推 tick**。
>
> ## 5. 交付与阻塞
> 新增：`docs/{MATRIX_SPEC,MATRIX,MATRIX_SUMMARY,MATRIX_PREVIEW,SOXL_SIM}.md`、`src/nt_pairs/sessions.py`（2026 NYSE 日历 + DST + 提前收盘）、`scripts/{build_matrix,screen_candidates,sim_soxl}.py`、`.field-guide/nautilus_lighter_data.md`（17 条环境事实）。**测试 92 全绿**（系统 python）/ 98（np2，含 nautilus 冒烟）。
>
> 未完成且已写明原因：**OKX/Binance 多窗口**（需要能访问 OKX 的出口）、**多 agent 复核**（配额 12-07 重置）、**`p_fill`/markout 标定**（需 L2 回放或实盘 fill 日志——这是「97% 胜率」能否成立的关键）、**Nautilus 2.0 节点启动**（2.0 移除了 `TradingNode`）。
>
> **下一步建议**：对 RKLB / MRVL / EWY / SOXL 四对做 fill 级验证（L2 回放 24h，标定 `p_fill` 与成交后 markout），同时把候选规模锁定在 $100–500/腿；在这之前不要放大名义额，也不要把 KORU/KIOXIA 的 +100 bps 当机会。

## C3 · 2026-11-12 · 成交率模型补充

> 成交率模型（`docs/FILL_MODEL.md`）—— 可靠输出与不可靠输出
>
> 可靠：**HL 主动流 16–218 笔/分 vs Lighter 0.04–2.8 笔/分** → maker 腿按 λ 选场所，不按场所名选。
> 不可靠：`P(fill)` 同一模型两次运行给出 3% 与 97%，差异全来自**贴价队列的单次快照**（1 vs 243 单位）→ 挂单前必须逐笔采样队列（≥3 次取中位数）。

【注入 · 2026-11-11 · 多窗口复核结论与裁决（来自 wF:pA，已落盘）】
5 个子窗口已对《对话2.md》《nautilus原生方案讨论.md》两段原文的 8 条断言逐条裁决，原始回复在 .herd-dispatch\discuss\*.reply.md，两段结论已追加进原文件末尾（原文件已备份 .bak-20261111）。

裁决（精简）：
1 小所当 Maker 主动腿——错：HL xyz 是深腿（SOXL $346M/日、NVDA $485M、ANT $116M），OKX 美股永续极薄（ASML $743/日）；Lighter 8 个目标仅命中 COIN。腿主被动须按标的判深。
2 TTL 固定 500ms 转市价——错：h*(k)=(k·hs/σ)^2·60s（0.44–1.4 s）；撤单→2 tick chase→50bps IOC，禁止市价。
3 门槛=费+滑点+估值偏置——过时：缺 funding carry(≈1.1bps)+腿风险+对账(0.5bps)，六项 b*≈19.6bps（旧 8.5）。500ms 窗口只多 1.3bps；追价 30s 补腿则 +3bps，腿风险是毒丸。
4 OKX L2 get_avg_px_for_quantity 反推保本价——对，1.219 已存在该 API。
5 Nautilus 已内置 HL/Lighter/OKX——半对：v1.231.0 才有 lighter，v1.222.0 只有 hyperliquid，本机 1.219.0 两者皆无。
6 FillModel 模拟 Maker 成交率——方向对，默认 Φ(0)=50% 严重高估（实测 0/6 成交），须 collar 扫描标定且标签 Δt 收到 500ms。
7 FuturesSpread 原子双腿——跨所不成立（HL grouping 仅 TP/SL、OKX batch 独立结算、Lighter OTO 仅同市场）；CryptoFuturesSpread 1.231 才有，OKX 无 spread 合约类型。
8 HL 配额用子账户释放——公式对、机制错：配额 per-address，子账户只补自身 10000 初始额；HL 只宜作被动腿。

新增引擎事实（已核上游）：HIP-3 在同一 HyperCore，instrument 形如 xyz:ANT-USD-PERP，但每 dex 自设部署方费率倍率（最多被分走一半）、默认逐仓、抵押可为 USDH/USDE/USDT0、oracle 由部署方运营；inferred OrderFilled 的 commission=None，自建账本不能用 adapter 的 realized pnl。Robinhood Chain = Lighter 的第二 deployment（USDG 结算，venue LIGHTER_ROBINHOOD），与 lighter 主部署同一适配器。

对现有 P0/P1/P2 路线图的影响：P0 四项优先级不变；新增两条 backlog——(a) 部署方费率倍率进 b* 的费率项（HIP-3 专用）；(b) 若启用 Nautilus 实盘，版本门槛 ≥1.231。
未验证：xyz:ANT 的 instrument provider 实际解析；OKX 股永续是否限美股时段（5x/限时段 vs 实测 lever=20 闭市成交）。

H3 · 2026-11-12 · 交付本项目（全量记录 + 回测报告 + 部署指导书 + 推送 GitHub）

"""Execution primitives (CONTRACT §4). Pure functions, no `nautilus_trader`.

Hedging is fill-driven and IOC-limit only — a market order is never

produced anywhere in this module. All prices/quantities are `Decimal`;

floats are rejected (:func:~nt_pairs.pair_spec.to_decimal).

"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from decimal import ROUND_CEILING, ROUND_FLOOR, Decimal

from .pair_spec import to_decimal

__all__ = [

"OrderSpec",

"MAX_COLLAR_BPS",

"FOLLOWER_STAGES",

"h_star_s",

"hedge_order",

"chase_price",

]

#: CONTRACT §4: hedging collar is at most 50 bps beyond the book.

MAX_COLLAR_BPS = Decimal("50")

_BPS_DIVISOR = Decimal("10000")

_SECONDS_PER_MINUTE = Decimal("60")

#: CONTRACT §4: stage ∈ {"t1_passive","t2_chase","t3_ioc"}; T1 is leader-only.

FOLLOWER_STAGES = frozenset({"t2_chase", "t3_ioc"})

_SIDE_BUY = "BUY"

_SIDE_SELL = "SELL"

@dataclass(frozen=True)

class OrderSpec:

"""Venue-agnostic limit order specification (never a market order)."""

side: str # "BUY" | "SELL"

qty: Decimal

price: Decimal

tif: str = "IOC"

reduce_only: bool = False

stage: str = "t3_ioc"

collar_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0")

def _ceil_to_tick(px: Decimal, tick: Decimal) -> Decimal:

return (px / tick).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING) * tick

def _floor_to_tick(px: Decimal, tick: Decimal) -> Decimal:

return (px / tick).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR) * tick

def _positive_decimal(field: str, value: object) -> Decimal:

dec = to_decimal(field, value)

if dec <= 0:

raise ValueError(f"{field} must be > 0 (got {dec})")

return dec

def h_star_s(

k: Decimal, half_spread_bps: Decimal, sigma_1m_bps: Decimal

) -> Decimal:

"""Hedge TTL budget in seconds: `(k half_spread / sigma)^2 60`.

`sigma_1m_bps <= 0` is a hard error (no volatility estimate → no

defensible TTL). `k must be > 0; half_spread_bps` must be >= 0.

"""

k = _positive_decimal("h_star_s.k", k)

half_spread_bps = to_decimal("h_star_s.half_spread_bps", half_spread_bps)

if half_spread_bps < 0:

raise ValueError(

f"h_star_s.half_spread_bps must be >= 0 (got {half_spread_bps})"

)

sigma_1m_bps = _positive_decimal("h_star_s.sigma_1m_bps", sigma_1m_bps)

return ((k * half_spread_bps / sigma_1m_bps) ** 2) * _SECONDS_PER_MINUTE

def hedge_order(

residual_qty: Decimal,

*,

book_bid: Decimal,

book_ask: Decimal,

tick: Decimal,

size_increment: Decimal,

min_qty: Decimal,

collar_bps: Decimal,

stage: str,

) -> OrderSpec | None:

"""Build the IOC hedge order for a signed follower residual.

`residual_qty > 0 → BUY follower to complete the hedge; < 0` → SELL.

Price: BUY = `book_ask * (1 + collar_bps/1e4)` rounded up to tick

(so BUY price >= ask always); SELL = `book_bid * (1 - collar_bps/1e4)`

rounded down to tick (SELL price <= bid always). Qty is floored to

`size_increment; if the result is < min_qty` (or residual is 0)

returns `None` — dust waits for the next fill.

`stage="t1_passive" raises ValueError`: the follower leg is never

passive. `0 <= collar_bps <= 50` is enforced (CONTRACT §4).

"""

if stage not in FOLLOWER_STAGES:

if stage == "t1_passive":

raise ValueError(

"hedge_order: stage='t1_passive' is leader-only; the follower "

"hedge must use 't2_chase' or 't3_ioc' (never passive)"

)

raise ValueError(

f"hedge_order: unknown stage {stage!r}; expected one of "

f"{sorted(FOLLOWER_STAGES)}"

)

residual_qty = to_decimal("hedge_order.residual_qty", residual_qty)

book_bid = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.book_bid", book_bid)

book_ask = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.book_ask", book_ask)

tick = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.tick", tick)

size_increment = _positive_decimal(

"hedge_order.size_increment", size_increment

)

min_qty = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.min_qty", min_qty)

collar_bps = to_decimal("hedge_order.collar_bps", collar_bps)

if collar_bps < 0 or collar_bps > MAX_COLLAR_BPS:

raise ValueError(

f"hedge_order.collar_bps must be within [0, {MAX_COLLAR_BPS}] "

f"(got {collar_bps})"

)

units = (abs(residual_qty) / size_increment).to_integral_value(

rounding=ROUND_FLOOR

)

qty = units * size_increment

if qty < min_qty:

return None # dust (incl. zero residual): wait for the next fill

if residual_qty > 0:

side = _SIDE_BUY

raw = book_ask * (

Decimal(1) + collar_bps / _BPS_DIVISOR

)

price = _ceil_to_tick(raw, tick)

else:

# residual_qty < 0 guaranteed here: qty >= min_qty > 0 rules out 0.

side = _SIDE_SELL

raw = book_bid * (

Decimal(1) - collar_bps / _BPS_DIVISOR

)

price = _floor_to_tick(raw, tick)

return OrderSpec(

side=side,

qty=qty,

price=price,

tif="IOC",

reduce_only=False,

stage=stage,

collar_bps=collar_bps,

)

def chase_price(

book_bid: Decimal,

book_ask: Decimal,

side: str,

tick: Decimal,

ticks: int,

) -> Decimal:

"""Chase-ladder price: BUY = `ask + tickstick, SELL = bid - tickstick`.

Result is normalised onto the tick grid (BUY rounded up, SELL rounded

down) and must stay > 0. `ticks must be a non-negative int`.

"""

if isinstance(ticks, bool) or not isinstance(ticks, int):

raise ValueError(f"chase_price: ticks must be an int, got {ticks!r}")

if ticks < 0:

raise ValueError(f"chase_price: ticks must be >= 0 (got {ticks})")

side_norm = side.upper() if isinstance(side, str) else side

if side_norm not in (_SIDE_BUY, _SIDE_SELL):

raise ValueError(

f"chase_price: side must be BUY or SELL, got {side!r}"

)

book_bid = _positive_decimal("chase_price.book_bid", book_bid)

book_ask = _positive_decimal("chase_price.book_ask", book_ask)

tick = _positive_decimal("chase_price.tick", tick)

step = Decimal(ticks) * tick

if side_norm == _SIDE_BUY:

price = _ceil_to_tick(book_ask + step, tick)

else:

price = _floor_to_tick(book_bid - step, tick)

if price <= 0:

raise ValueError(

f"chase_price: {side_norm} ladder ran to non-positive price "

f"{price} (ticks={ticks}, tick={tick})"

)

return price

"""Execution primitives (CONTRACT §4). Pure functions, no ``nautilus_trader``.

Hedging is fill-driven and **IOC-limit only** — a market order is never
produced anywhere in this module. All prices/quantities are ``Decimal``;
floats are rejected (:func:`~nt_pairs.pair_spec.to_decimal`).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import ROUND_CEILING, ROUND_FLOOR, Decimal

from .pair_spec import to_decimal

__all__ = [
    "OrderSpec",
    "MAX_COLLAR_BPS",
    "FOLLOWER_STAGES",
    "h_star_s",
    "hedge_order",
    "chase_price",
]

#: CONTRACT §4: hedging collar is at most 50 bps beyond the book.
MAX_COLLAR_BPS = Decimal("50")
_BPS_DIVISOR = Decimal("10000")
_SECONDS_PER_MINUTE = Decimal("60")

#: CONTRACT §4: stage ∈ {"t1_passive","t2_chase","t3_ioc"}; T1 is leader-only.
FOLLOWER_STAGES = frozenset({"t2_chase", "t3_ioc"})

_SIDE_BUY = "BUY"
_SIDE_SELL = "SELL"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class OrderSpec:
    """Venue-agnostic limit order specification (never a market order)."""

    side: str                      # "BUY" | "SELL"
    qty: Decimal
    price: Decimal
    tif: str = "IOC"
    reduce_only: bool = False
    stage: str = "t3_ioc"
    collar_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0")


def _ceil_to_tick(px: Decimal, tick: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    return (px / tick).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING) * tick


def _floor_to_tick(px: Decimal, tick: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    return (px / tick).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR) * tick


def _positive_decimal(field: str, value: object) -> Decimal:
    dec = to_decimal(field, value)
    if dec <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be > 0 (got {dec})")
    return dec


def h_star_s(
    k: Decimal, half_spread_bps: Decimal, sigma_1m_bps: Decimal
) -> Decimal:
    """Hedge TTL budget in seconds: ``(k * half_spread / sigma)^2 * 60``.

    ``sigma_1m_bps <= 0`` is a hard error (no volatility estimate → no
    defensible TTL). ``k`` must be > 0; ``half_spread_bps`` must be >= 0.
    """
    k = _positive_decimal("h_star_s.k", k)
    half_spread_bps = to_decimal("h_star_s.half_spread_bps", half_spread_bps)
    if half_spread_bps < 0:
        raise ValueError(
            f"h_star_s.half_spread_bps must be >= 0 (got {half_spread_bps})"
        )
    sigma_1m_bps = _positive_decimal("h_star_s.sigma_1m_bps", sigma_1m_bps)
    return ((k * half_spread_bps / sigma_1m_bps) ** 2) * _SECONDS_PER_MINUTE


def hedge_order(
    residual_qty: Decimal,
    *,
    book_bid: Decimal,
    book_ask: Decimal,
    tick: Decimal,
    size_increment: Decimal,
    min_qty: Decimal,
    collar_bps: Decimal,
    stage: str,
) -> OrderSpec | None:
    """Build the IOC hedge order for a signed follower residual.

    ``residual_qty > 0`` → BUY follower to complete the hedge; ``< 0`` → SELL.
    Price: BUY = ``book_ask * (1 + collar_bps/1e4)`` rounded **up** to tick
    (so BUY price >= ask always); SELL = ``book_bid * (1 - collar_bps/1e4)``
    rounded **down** to tick (SELL price <= bid always). Qty is floored to
    ``size_increment``; if the result is ``< min_qty`` (or residual is 0)
    returns ``None`` — dust waits for the next fill.

    ``stage="t1_passive"`` raises ``ValueError``: the follower leg is never
    passive. ``0 <= collar_bps <= 50`` is enforced (CONTRACT §4).
    """
    if stage not in FOLLOWER_STAGES:
        if stage == "t1_passive":
            raise ValueError(
                "hedge_order: stage='t1_passive' is leader-only; the follower "
                "hedge must use 't2_chase' or 't3_ioc' (never passive)"
            )
        raise ValueError(
            f"hedge_order: unknown stage {stage!r}; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(FOLLOWER_STAGES)}"
        )
    residual_qty = to_decimal("hedge_order.residual_qty", residual_qty)
    book_bid = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.book_bid", book_bid)
    book_ask = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.book_ask", book_ask)
    tick = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.tick", tick)
    size_increment = _positive_decimal(
        "hedge_order.size_increment", size_increment
    )
    min_qty = _positive_decimal("hedge_order.min_qty", min_qty)
    collar_bps = to_decimal("hedge_order.collar_bps", collar_bps)
    if collar_bps < 0 or collar_bps > MAX_COLLAR_BPS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"hedge_order.collar_bps must be within [0, {MAX_COLLAR_BPS}] "
            f"(got {collar_bps})"
        )

    units = (abs(residual_qty) / size_increment).to_integral_value(
        rounding=ROUND_FLOOR
    )
    qty = units * size_increment
    if qty < min_qty:
        return None  # dust (incl. zero residual): wait for the next fill

    if residual_qty > 0:
        side = _SIDE_BUY
        raw = book_ask * (
            Decimal(1) + collar_bps / _BPS_DIVISOR
        )
        price = _ceil_to_tick(raw, tick)
    else:
        # residual_qty < 0 guaranteed here: qty >= min_qty > 0 rules out 0.
        side = _SIDE_SELL
        raw = book_bid * (
            Decimal(1) - collar_bps / _BPS_DIVISOR
        )
        price = _floor_to_tick(raw, tick)

    return OrderSpec(
        side=side,
        qty=qty,
        price=price,
        tif="IOC",
        reduce_only=False,
        stage=stage,
        collar_bps=collar_bps,
    )


def chase_price(
    book_bid: Decimal,
    book_ask: Decimal,
    side: str,
    tick: Decimal,
    ticks: int,
) -> Decimal:
    """Chase-ladder price: BUY = ``ask + ticks*tick``, SELL = ``bid - ticks*tick``.

    Result is normalised onto the tick grid (BUY rounded up, SELL rounded
    down) and must stay > 0. ``ticks`` must be a non-negative ``int``.
    """
    if isinstance(ticks, bool) or not isinstance(ticks, int):
        raise ValueError(f"chase_price: ticks must be an int, got {ticks!r}")
    if ticks < 0:
        raise ValueError(f"chase_price: ticks must be >= 0 (got {ticks})")
    side_norm = side.upper() if isinstance(side, str) else side
    if side_norm not in (_SIDE_BUY, _SIDE_SELL):
        raise ValueError(
            f"chase_price: side must be BUY or SELL, got {side!r}"
        )
    book_bid = _positive_decimal("chase_price.book_bid", book_bid)
    book_ask = _positive_decimal("chase_price.book_ask", book_ask)
    tick = _positive_decimal("chase_price.tick", tick)

    step = Decimal(ticks) * tick
    if side_norm == _SIDE_BUY:
        price = _ceil_to_tick(book_ask + step, tick)
    else:
        price = _floor_to_tick(book_bid - step, tick)
    if price <= 0:
        raise ValueError(
            f"chase_price: {side_norm} ladder ran to non-positive price "
            f"{price} (ticks={ticks}, tick={tick})"
        )
    return price

"""Target-based fill ledger (CONTRACT §3). Pure logic, no `nautilus_trader`.

Event source in production: Nautilus `OrderFilled (last_qty`,

`order_side, instrument_id, trade_id`) — but this module only needs

the primitives below.

Hard rules implemented here:

  • Target-based: positions are signed sums of applied fills; the hedge

target is recomputed from the leader position every time, so no ack order

can inflate the position.

  • `fee is None` (HL inferred fills carry no commission) is counted in

:attr:LegLedger.missing_fee_count and contributes 0 — the fee is NEVER

guessed from notional.

  • Duplicate `trade_id` delivery is ignored and counted in

:attr:LegLedger.duplicates.

"""

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

from .pair_spec import PairSpec, to_decimal

__all__ = ["LegLedger"]

_ZERO = Decimal(0)

class LegLedger:

"""Signed per-venue quantity book with idempotent fill application."""

def __init__(

self, leader_venue: str, follower_venue: str, ratio: Decimal

) -> None:

if leader_venue == follower_venue:

raise ValueError(

"LegLedger: leader and follower venue must differ "

f"(both {leader_venue!r})"

)

ratio = to_decimal("LegLedger.ratio", ratio)

if ratio <= 0:

raise ValueError(f"LegLedger.ratio must be > 0 (got {ratio})")

self.leader_venue = leader_venue

self.follower_venue = follower_venue

self.ratio = ratio

#: duplicate trade_id deliveries ignored so far

self.duplicates = 0

#: fills applied with fee=None so far

self.missing_fee_count = 0

self._q: dict[str, Decimal] = {

leader_venue: _ZERO,

follower_venue: _ZERO,

}

self._net_fees = _ZERO

self._seen_trade_ids: set[str] = set()

@classmethod

def from_spec(cls, spec: PairSpec) -> "LegLedger":

"""Build a ledger from a :class:~nt_pairs.pair_spec.PairSpec."""

return cls(spec.leader.venue, spec.follower.venue, spec.ratio)

def on_fill(

self,

trade_id: str,

venue: str,

side: str,

qty: Decimal,

px: Decimal,

fee: Decimal | None,

) -> None:

"""Apply one fill; idempotent on `trade_id`.

`qty is unsigned (> 0); the sign comes from side` (BUY = +,

SELL = −). Invalid fills raise `ValueError` and consume nothing —

the trade_id is only marked seen after the fill is fully applied.

"""

if trade_id in self._seen_trade_ids:

self.duplicates += 1

return

if not trade_id:

raise ValueError("on_fill: trade_id must be a non-empty string")

if venue not in self._q:

raise ValueError(

f"on_fill: unknown venue {venue!r}; expected "

f"{self.leader_venue!r} or {self.follower_venue!r}"

)

side_norm = side.upper() if isinstance(side, str) else side

if side_norm not in ("BUY", "SELL"):

raise ValueError(

f"on_fill: side must be BUY or SELL, got {side!r}"

)

qty = to_decimal("on_fill.qty", qty)

if qty <= 0:

raise ValueError(f"on_fill.qty must be > 0 (got {qty})")

px = to_decimal("on_fill.px", px)

if px <= 0:

raise ValueError(f"on_fill.px must be > 0 (got {px})")

signed = qty if side_norm == "BUY" else -qty

self._q[venue] += signed

if fee is None:

# Never guess the fee from notional (CONTRACT §3).

self.missing_fee_count += 1

else:

self._net_fees += to_decimal("on_fill.fee", fee)

self._seen_trade_ids.add(trade_id)

def q(self, venue: str) -> Decimal:

"""Signed net quantity at `venue` (BUY positive, SELL negative)."""

try:

return self._q[venue]

except KeyError:

raise ValueError(

f"q: unknown venue {venue!r}; expected "

f"{self.leader_venue!r} or {self.follower_venue!r}"

) from None

def target_follower(self) -> Decimal:

"""Follower position that fully hedges the leader: `-q_leader * ratio`."""

return -self.q(self.leader_venue) * self.ratio

def residual(self) -> Decimal:

"""`target_follower() - q(follower)`, signed.

> 0 → still need to BUY that much follower; < 0 → need to SELL.

"""

return self.target_follower() - self.q(self.follower_venue)

def naked_leader_equiv(self) -> Decimal:

"""Unhedged position in leader units: `q_leader + q_follower / ratio`."""

return self.q(self.leader_venue) + self.q(self.follower_venue) / self.ratio

def unhedged_usd(self, ref_px: Decimal) -> Decimal:

"""Absolute naked leader-equivalent exposure valued at `ref_px`."""

ref_px = to_decimal("unhedged_usd.ref_px", ref_px)

if ref_px <= 0:

raise ValueError(f"unhedged_usd.ref_px must be > 0 (got {ref_px})")

return abs(self.naked_leader_equiv()) * ref_px

def net_fees(self) -> Decimal:

"""Sum of all applied fees (negative fees = rebates); None-fees add 0."""

return self._net_fees

def snapshot(self) -> dict:

"""Point-in-time dict view for logging/risk (keys are stable)."""

return {

"q_leader": self.q(self.leader_venue),

"q_follower": self.q(self.follower_venue),

"target": self.target_follower(),

"residual": self.residual(),

"naked": self.naked_leader_equiv(),

"net_fees": self.net_fees(),

"duplicates": self.duplicates,

"missing_fee_count": self.missing_fee_count,

}

        """Build a ledger from a :class:`~nt_pairs.pair_spec.PairSpec`."""

"""腿选择策略（纯函数，零 IO）。

2026-11-12 的实测结论改了选腿顺序：费率 → 点差 → 深度 → 成交概率。

把对腿从 Lighter（0 费）换成 OKX（maker2+taker5）后，胜率仍是 95~100%，但净 EV 从

+0.5~+14.0 bps/轮 翻成 −6.7~−13.0 bps/轮 —— 差额 100% 来自费率。

本模块把这条规则写成可测的纯函数，供 strategy.py / 选票脚本调用。

"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from decimal import Decimal

from typing import Iterable, Optional

@dataclass(frozen=True)

class LegQuote:

"""一个场所/标的在某一时刻的可交易报价（只含决策需要的字段）。"""

venue: str

instrument_id: str

maker_bps: Decimal

taker_bps: Decimal

half_spread_bps: Decimal

depth25_usd: Decimal

tick: Decimal

price: Decimal

p_fill: Optional[Decimal] = None # maker 侧在目标 TTL 内的成交概率（可未知）

carry_bps_h: Decimal = Decimal("0")

@property

def key(self) -> str:

return f"{self.venue}:{self.instrument_id}"

def slip_bps(q: LegQuote, qty_usd: Decimal, ticks: int = 2, cap_bps: Decimal = Decimal("50")) -> Decimal:

"""按目标规模吃盘口的滑点估计：至少 ticks 个 tick，受 cap_bps 限制。"""

if q.price <= 0 or qty_usd <= 0:

return Decimal("0")

raw = Decimal(ticks) q.tick / q.price Decimal("10000")

return min(raw, cap_bps)

def maker_cost_bps(q: LegQuote) -> Decimal:

"""做 maker 一侧的成本：maker 费 + 半价差（机会成本）。"""

return q.maker_bps + q.half_spread_bps

def taker_cost_bps(q: LegQuote, qty_usd: Decimal) -> Decimal:

"""做 taker 一侧的成本：taker 费 + 半价差 + 按规模滑点。"""

return q.taker_bps + q.half_spread_bps + slip_bps(q, qty_usd)

def carry_bps(q: LegQuote, hold_hours: Decimal) -> Decimal:

return abs(q.carry_bps_h) * hold_hours

def pair_cost_bps(maker_leg: LegQuote, taker_leg: LegQuote, qty_usd: Decimal, *,

hold_hours: Decimal = Decimal("1"),

leg_risk_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0.3"),

recon_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0.5")) -> Decimal:

"""一轮（开仓 + 平仓各一次）的摩擦成本，按腿角色计入。"""

return (maker_cost_bps(maker_leg) + taker_cost_bps(taker_leg, qty_usd)

  • carry_bps(maker_leg, hold_hours) + carry_bps(taker_leg, hold_hours)
  • leg_risk_bps + recon_bps)

def expected_net_bps(maker_leg: LegQuote, taker_leg: LegQuote, capture_bps: Decimal,

qty_usd: Decimal, **kw) -> Decimal:

"""一轮的期望净边际（bps/轮）：p_fill × (捕获 − 成本)；p_fill 未知时按 1 计（乐观上界）。"""

cost = pair_cost_bps(maker_leg, taker_leg, qty_usd, **kw)

p = maker_leg.p_fill if maker_leg.p_fill is not None else Decimal("1")

return p * (capture_bps - cost)

def rank_legs(quotes: Iterable[LegQuote], role: str, qty_usd: Decimal) -> list[LegQuote]:

"""按「费率 → 点差 → 深度 → 成交概率」排序。

role="taker"：成本 = taker 费 + 半价差 + 滑点。

同成本时深度大的优先；深度再同则成交概率高的优先。

"""

cost = maker_cost_bps(q) if role == "maker" else taker_cost_bps(q, qty_usd)

pf = q.p_fill if q.p_fill is not None else Decimal("-1")

return (cost, -q.depth25_usd, -pf)

return sorted(quotes, key=key)

) -> tuple[Optional[LegQuote], Optional[LegQuote], Decimal]:

"""在候选腿集合里挑「maker 腿 + taker 腿」的最优组合。

if m.key == t.key:

continue

if net > best[2]:

best = (m, t, net)

if best[0] is None:

return best

实测（2026-11-12，30 天 1h）：Lighter 侧 RKLB 31%、KORU 36%、KIOXIA 高达 93%；

MRVL 4%、EWY 5%、SOXL 1%；HL 侧全部 ≤1%。

def __init__(self, threshold_pct: float = 10.0, min_samples: int = 30) -> None:

self.threshold_pct = Decimal(str(threshold_pct))

self.min_samples = int(min_samples)

self._closes: list[Decimal] = []

self._closes.append(close)

if len(self._closes) > 2000:

def repeat_pct(self) -> Decimal:

return (Decimal(same) * 100 / Decimal(len(self._closes) - 1)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))

return self.samples >= self.min_samples and self.repeat_pct() > self.threshold_pct

self._closes.clear()

原文（逐字，raw）
"""腿选择策略（纯函数，零 IO）。

2026-11-12 的实测结论改了选腿顺序：**费率 → 点差 → 深度 → 成交概率**。
把对腿从 Lighter（0 费）换成 OKX（maker2+taker5）后，胜率仍是 95~100%，但净 EV 从
+0.5~+14.0 bps/轮 翻成 −6.7~−13.0 bps/轮 —— 差额 100% 来自费率。

本模块把这条规则写成可测的纯函数，供 `strategy.py` / 选票脚本调用。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Iterable, Optional


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LegQuote:
    """一个场所/标的在某一时刻的可交易报价（只含决策需要的字段）。"""

    venue: str
    instrument_id: str
    maker_bps: Decimal
    taker_bps: Decimal
    half_spread_bps: Decimal
    depth25_usd: Decimal
    tick: Decimal
    price: Decimal
    p_fill: Optional[Decimal] = None      # maker 侧在目标 TTL 内的成交概率（可未知）
    carry_bps_h: Decimal = Decimal("0")

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.venue}:{self.instrument_id}"


def slip_bps(q: LegQuote, qty_usd: Decimal, ticks: int = 2, cap_bps: Decimal = Decimal("50")) -> Decimal:
    """按目标规模吃盘口的滑点估计：至少 `ticks` 个 tick，受 `cap_bps` 限制。"""
    if q.price <= 0 or qty_usd <= 0:
        return Decimal("0")
    raw = Decimal(ticks) * q.tick / q.price * Decimal("10000")
    return min(raw, cap_bps)


def maker_cost_bps(q: LegQuote) -> Decimal:
    """做 maker 一侧的成本：maker 费 + 半价差（机会成本）。"""
    return q.maker_bps + q.half_spread_bps


def taker_cost_bps(q: LegQuote, qty_usd: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """做 taker 一侧的成本：taker 费 + 半价差 + 按规模滑点。"""
    return q.taker_bps + q.half_spread_bps + slip_bps(q, qty_usd)


def carry_bps(q: LegQuote, hold_hours: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    return abs(q.carry_bps_h) * hold_hours


def pair_cost_bps(maker_leg: LegQuote, taker_leg: LegQuote, qty_usd: Decimal, *,
                  hold_hours: Decimal = Decimal("1"),
                  leg_risk_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0.3"),
                  recon_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0.5")) -> Decimal:
    """一轮（开仓 + 平仓各一次）的摩擦成本，按腿角色计入。"""
    return (maker_cost_bps(maker_leg) + taker_cost_bps(taker_leg, qty_usd)
            + carry_bps(maker_leg, hold_hours) + carry_bps(taker_leg, hold_hours)
            + leg_risk_bps + recon_bps)


def expected_net_bps(maker_leg: LegQuote, taker_leg: LegQuote, capture_bps: Decimal,
                      qty_usd: Decimal, **kw) -> Decimal:
    """一轮的期望净边际（bps/轮）：`p_fill × (捕获 − 成本)`；`p_fill` 未知时按 1 计（乐观上界）。"""
    cost = pair_cost_bps(maker_leg, taker_leg, qty_usd, **kw)
    p = maker_leg.p_fill if maker_leg.p_fill is not None else Decimal("1")
    return p * (capture_bps - cost)


def rank_legs(quotes: Iterable[LegQuote], role: str, qty_usd: Decimal) -> list[LegQuote]:
    """按「费率 → 点差 → 深度 → 成交概率」排序。

    role="maker"：成本 = maker 费 + 半价差；
    role="taker"：成本 = taker 费 + 半价差 + 滑点。
    同成本时深度大的优先；深度再同则成交概率高的优先。
    """
    def key(q: LegQuote):
        cost = maker_cost_bps(q) if role == "maker" else taker_cost_bps(q, qty_usd)
        pf = q.p_fill if q.p_fill is not None else Decimal("-1")
        return (cost, -q.depth25_usd, -pf)

    return sorted(quotes, key=key)


def select_pair(quotes: Iterable[LegQuote], capture_bps: Decimal, qty_usd: Decimal, **kw
                ) -> tuple[Optional[LegQuote], Optional[LegQuote], Decimal]:
    """在候选腿集合里挑「maker 腿 + taker 腿」的最优组合。

    返回 (maker_leg, taker_leg, expected_net_bps)；候选不足 2 条时返回 (None, None, 0)。
    约束：maker 与 taker 必须是不同标的（避免自成交）；同标的不允许。
    """
    qs = list(quotes)
    best = (None, None, Decimal("-1e9"))
    for m in qs:
        for t in qs:
            if m.key == t.key:
                continue
            net = expected_net_bps(m, t, capture_bps, qty_usd, **kw)
            if net > best[2]:
                best = (m, t, net)
    if best[0] is None:
        return None, None, Decimal("0")
    return best


class RepeatedCloseDetector:
    """陈旧报价检测器：连续 close 相同的比例（薄市场的关键数据质量指标）。

    实测（2026-11-12，30 天 1h）：Lighter 侧 RKLB 31%、KORU 36%、KIOXIA 高达 93%；
    MRVL 4%、EWY 5%、SOXL 1%；HL 侧全部 ≤1%。
    重复率高的腿，其「基差回归」是沿用旧打印的机械假象，**不可交易**。
    """

    def __init__(self, threshold_pct: float = 10.0, min_samples: int = 30) -> None:
        self.threshold_pct = Decimal(str(threshold_pct))
        self.min_samples = int(min_samples)
        self._closes: list[Decimal] = []

    def push(self, close: Decimal) -> None:
        self._closes.append(close)
        if len(self._closes) > 2000:
            self._closes.pop(0)

    @property
    def samples(self) -> int:
        return len(self._closes)

    def repeat_pct(self) -> Decimal:
        if len(self._closes) < 2:
            return Decimal("0")
        same = sum(1 for a, b in zip(self._closes, self._closes[1:]) if a == b)
        return (Decimal(same) * 100 / Decimal(len(self._closes) - 1)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))

    def is_stale(self) -> bool:
        return self.samples >= self.min_samples and self.repeat_pct() > self.threshold_pct

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._closes.clear()


def leg_risk_bps(sigma_basis_bps: Decimal, t_leg_s: Decimal, p_one_leg: Decimal,
                 alpha: Decimal = Decimal("0.5")) -> Decimal:
    """腿风险溢价：`√(2/π)·σ·√(t/60)·P·α`。"""
    import math
    if sigma_basis_bps <= 0:
        return Decimal("0")
    v = math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) * float(sigma_basis_bps) * math.sqrt(float(t_leg_s) / 60.0) \
        * float(p_one_leg) * float(alpha)
    return Decimal(str(v))

book_max_age_ms: int,

) -> LivePlan:

"""校验场所并生成订阅列表。"""

for leg in (leader, follower):

if leg.venue not in SUPPORTED_VENUES:

raise ValueError(

f"{p.name}: unsupported venue {leg.venue!r} "

f"(supported: {', '.join(SUPPORTED_VENUES)})"

)

if leg.max_qty <= 0:

raise ValueError(f"{p.name}: {leg.role}.max_qty must be > 0")

subscriptions = (

SubscriptionPlan(leader.instrument_id, "L2_MBP", leader.role, leader.venue),

SubscriptionPlan(follower.instrument_id, "L2_MBP", follower.role, follower.venue),

)

return LivePlan(

name=name,

leader=leader,

follower=follower,

ratio=ratio,

sigma_1m_bps=sigma_1m_bps,

max_leg_usd=max_leg_usd,

dry_run=dry_run,

state_dir=state_dir,

book_max_age_ms=book_max_age_ms,

subscriptions=subscriptions,

)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

客户端配置装配

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)

class ClientSpec:

"""一个待注册客户端的装配描述。"""

name: str

kind: str # "data" | "exec" | "sim_exec"

factory: Any

config: Any

venue: str

def _hyperliquid_data_config(environment: HyperliquidEnvironment) -> HyperliquidDataClientConfig:

return HyperliquidDataClientConfig(environment=environment)

def _lighter_data_config(environment: LighterEnvironment) -> LighterDataClientConfig:

return LighterDataClientConfig(

environment=environment,

deployment=LighterDeployment.LIGHTER,

)

def _sandbox_exec_config(venue: str, leg: LegPlan) -> SandboxExecutionClientConfig:

"""沙盒执行端（dry-run 唯一允许的执行入口）。

2.0 要求显式给 fee_model（连零费率模型也必须显式给），否则

`SandboxExecutionClientConfig 直接抛 RuntimeError`。

费率取自该腿配置的 maker/taker bps。

"""

usd = Currency.from_str("USD")

maker_rate = Decimal(leg.maker_fee_bps) / Decimal(10_000)

taker_rate = Decimal(leg.taker_fee_bps) / Decimal(10_000)

return SandboxExecutionClientConfig(

venue=Venue(venue),

starting_balances=[Money(1_000_000, usd)],

base_currency=usd,

fee_model=MakerTakerFeeModel(maker_rate=maker_rate, taker_rate=taker_rate),

)

def _hyperliquid_exec_config(environment: HyperliquidEnvironment) -> HyperliquidExecutionClientConfig:

"""实盘 HL 执行端——只在这里读取私钥。"""

private_key = os.environ.get("HL_PRIVATE_KEY")

account_address = os.environ.get("HL_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS")

if not private_key:

raise MissingCredentials(VENUE_HYPERLIQUID, ["HL_PRIVATE_KEY"])

return HyperliquidExecutionClientConfig(

account_address=account_address,

private_key=private_key,

environment=environment,

)

def _lighter_exec_config(environment: LighterEnvironment) -> LighterExecutionClientConfig:

"""实盘 Lighter 执行端——只在这里读取私钥。"""

private_key = os.environ.get("LIGHTER_PRIVATE_KEY")

account_index = os.environ.get("LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX")

if not private_key:

raise MissingCredentials(VENUE_LIGHTER, ["LIGHTER_PRIVATE_KEY"])

return LighterExecutionClientConfig(

account_id=AccountId(os.environ.get("LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_ID", "LIGHTER-001")),

account_index=int(account_index) if account_index else None,

api_key_index=int(os.environ.get("LIGHTER_API_KEY_INDEX", "4")),

private_key=private_key,

environment=environment,

deployment=LighterDeployment.LIGHTER,

)

def _leg_for_venue(plan: LivePlan, venue: str) -> LegPlan:

"""按场所取腿（同一 pair 两腿不同场所）。"""

for leg in (plan.leader, plan.follower):

if leg.venue == venue:

return leg

raise ValueError(f"no leg configured for venue {venue!r}")

def build_client_specs(

plan: LivePlan,

*,

dry_run: Optional[bool] = None,

environment: str = "mainnet",

) -> list[ClientSpec]:

"""生成客户端装配列表（不建立网络连接）。

Args:

plan: :class:LivePlan。

dry_run: 覆盖 `plan.dry_run；True` 时不读取任何凭据，执行端用沙盒。

environment: `"mainnet" 或 "testnet"`。

Returns:

:class:ClientSpec 列表（先数据端、后执行端）。

"""

use_dry_run = plan.dry_run if dry_run is None else bool(dry_run)

hl_env = (

HyperliquidEnvironment.MAINNET

if environment == "mainnet"

else HyperliquidEnvironment.TESTNET

)

lt_env = (

LighterEnvironment.MAINNET

if environment == "mainnet"

else LighterEnvironment.TESTNET

)

specs: list[ClientSpec] = []

for venue in plan.venues:

if venue == VENUE_HYPERLIQUID:

specs.append(

ClientSpec(

name="hyperliquid",

kind="data",

factory=HyperliquidDataClientFactory(),

config=_hyperliquid_data_config(hl_env),

venue=venue,

)

)

elif venue == VENUE_LIGHTER:

specs.append(

ClientSpec(

name="lighter",

kind="data",

factory=LighterDataClientFactory(),

config=_lighter_data_config(lt_env),

venue=venue,

)

)

else: # pragma: no cover - load_live_plan 已校验

raise ValueError(f"unsupported venue {venue!r}")

for venue in plan.venues:

if use_dry_run:

specs.append(

ClientSpec(

name=f"{venue.lower()}-sim",

kind="sim_exec",

factory=SandboxExecutionClientFactory(),

config=_sandbox_exec_config(venue, _leg_for_venue(plan, venue)),

venue=venue,

)

)

continue

if venue == VENUE_HYPERLIQUID:

specs.append(

ClientSpec(

name="hyperliquid",

kind="exec",

factory=HyperliquidExecutionClientFactory(),

config=_hyperliquid_exec_config(hl_env),

venue=venue,

)

)

elif venue == VENUE_LIGHTER:

specs.append(

ClientSpec(

name="lighter",

kind="exec",

factory=LighterExecutionClientFactory(),

config=_lighter_exec_config(lt_env),

venue=venue,

)

)

return specs

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

心跳 actor

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class PairHeartbeatActor(DataActor):

"""每 5 秒打一条心跳，并汇报两腿的订阅状态。

心跳字段：盘口时间戳、两腿 mid、基差（bps）、residual、naked_age（秒）。

数据流只订阅一次：由 :class:~nt_pairs.strategy.PairHedgeStrategy 在

`on_start` 里订阅两腿 L2_MBP。本 actor 不重复订阅，改为读策略维护的

`book_ts`（收到过 deltas 即视为订阅成功）以及 cache 里的盘口，

避免同一 instrument 出现两条数据流。

"""

def __new__(cls, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:

# 2.0 的 DataActor.__new__ 只接受 0~1 个位置参数，自定义构造参数需在此吞掉。

return super().__new__(cls)

def __init__(self, strategy: PairHedgeStrategy, plan: LivePlan) -> None:

super().__init__()

self._strategy = strategy

self._plan = plan

self._ticks = 0

# -- 生命周期 ---------------------------------------------------------

def on_start(self) -> None:

self.clock.set_timer(

name="heartbeat",

interval=timedelta(seconds=5),

callback=self._on_heartbeat,

)

self.log.info(

f"heartbeat actor started instruments={list(self._plan.instrument_ids)}"

)

def on_stop(self) -> None:

self.log.info("heartbeat actor stopped")

# -- 心跳 -------------------------------------------------------------

def _on_heartbeat(self, event: Any = None) -> None:

self._ticks += 1

now = self.clock.timestamp_ns() / 1e9

book_ts = dict(getattr(self._strategy, "book_ts", {}) or {})

mids: dict[str, Optional[float]] = {}

for sub in self._plan.subscriptions:

mids[sub.instrument_id] = self._mid(sub.instrument_id)

leader_mid = mids.get(self._plan.leader.instrument_id)

follower_mid = mids.get(self._plan.follower.instrument_id)

basis_bps: Optional[float] = None

if leader_mid and follower_mid and leader_mid > 0:

basis_bps = (follower_mid / leader_mid - 1.0) * 1e4

residual = self._strategy.ledger.residual()

naked_since = getattr(self._strategy, "naked_since", None)

naked_age = None if naked_since is None else round(now - float(naked_since), 3)

payload = {

"kind": "heartbeat",

"tick": self._ticks,

"ts_event": book_ts,

"mid": mids,

"basis_bps": basis_bps,

"residual": str(residual),

"naked_age_s": naked_age,

"subscribed": self.subscription_status(),

}

self.log.info(json.dumps(payload, default=str))

def _mid(self, instrument_id: str) -> Optional[float]:

try:

book = self.cache.order_book(InstrumentId.from_str(instrument_id))

except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 - cache 尚未有该 book

return None

if book is None:

return None

bid, ask = book.best_bid_price(), book.best_ask_price()

if not bid or not ask:

return None

return float(bid + ask) / 2.0

def subscription_status(self) -> dict[str, bool]:

"""每条腿的订阅状态（策略收到过该腿的 deltas 即为 True）。"""

book_ts = getattr(self._strategy, "book_ts", {}) or {}

return {

sub.instrument_id: str(sub.instrument_id) in book_ts

for sub in self._plan.subscriptions

}

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

节点装配

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass

class NodeBundle:

"""构建好的节点及其附属对象。"""

node: LiveNode

plan: LivePlan

strategy: PairHedgeStrategy

heartbeat: PairHeartbeatActor

client_specs: list[ClientSpec]

def build_node(

plan: LivePlan,

*,

dry_run: Optional[bool] = None,

environment: str = "mainnet",

node_name: Optional[str] = None,

) -> NodeBundle:

"""按计划组装 `LiveNode`（不启动网络循环）。

策略注册入口为 `LiveNode.add_strategy(instance)`（实测 2.0.0rc6：

`LiveNodeConfig 没有 strategies 字段，LiveNodeBuilder` 也没有

`with_strategy；只有 node 级别的 add_strategy` /

`add_strategy_from_config / add_builtin_strategy`）。

"""

use_dry_run = plan.dry_run if dry_run is None else bool(dry_run)

specs = build_client_specs(plan, dry_run=use_dry_run, environment=environment)

config = LiveNodeConfig(

environment=None,

load_state=False,

save_state=False,

shutdown_on_error=True,

)

builder = LiveNodeBuilder.from_config(node_name or plan.name, config)

for spec in specs:

if spec.kind == "data":

builder.add_data_client(spec.name, spec.factory, spec.config)

elif spec.kind == "exec":

builder.add_exec_client(spec.name, spec.factory, spec.config)

else:

builder.add_simulated_exec_client(spec.name, spec.factory, spec.config)

node = builder.build()

strategy_config = PairHedgeConfig(

leader_id=plan.leader.instrument_id,

follower_id=plan.follower.instrument_id,

ratio=str(plan.ratio),

sigma_1m_bps=str(plan.sigma_1m_bps),

max_leg_qty=str(plan.leader.max_qty),

book_max_age_ms=plan.book_max_age_ms,

dry_run=use_dry_run,

state_dir=plan.state_dir,

)

strategy = PairHedgeStrategy(strategy_config)

node.add_strategy(strategy)

heartbeat = PairHeartbeatActor(strategy, plan)

node.add_actor(heartbeat)

return NodeBundle(

node=node,

plan=plan,

strategy=strategy,

heartbeat=heartbeat,

client_specs=specs,

)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

凭据自检

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _iter_config_objects(obj: Any, depth: int = 0):

"""递归遍历配置对象（属性型 pyo3 类）。"""

if obj is None or depth > 3:

return

yield obj

for name in dir(obj):

if name.startswith("_"):

continue

try:

value = getattr(obj, name)

except Exception: # noqa: BLE001

continue

if callable(value):

continue

if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, Decimal)):

continue

if hasattr(value, "__dict__") or type(value).__module__.startswith("nautilus_trader"):

yield from _iter_config_objects(value, depth + 1)

def scan_secret_fields(bundle: NodeBundle) -> dict[str, Any]:

"""扫描装配结果里的凭据字段。

Returns:

`{"populated": [...], "fields": {field: value}}——populated` 列出

有值的凭据字段；dry-run 下必须为空。

"""

populated: list[str] = []

fields: dict[str, Any] = {}

targets: list[Any] = [bundle.node]

targets.extend(spec.config for spec in bundle.client_specs)

for obj in targets:

for candidate in _iter_config_objects(obj):

for field_name in SECRET_FIELD_NAMES:

if not hasattr(candidate, field_name):

continue

value = getattr(candidate, field_name)

fields.setdefault(field_name, value)

if value:

populated.append(f"{type(candidate).__name__}.{field_name}")

return {"populated": populated, "fields": fields}

原文（逐字，raw）
"""NautilusTrader 2.0 ``LiveNode`` 装配层（实盘节点接线）。

2.0.0rc6 移除了 1.x 的 ``TradingNode`` / ``TradingNodeConfig``，改为
``nautilus_trader.live`` 里的 ``LiveNode`` / ``LiveNodeBuilder`` / ``LiveNodeConfig``。
本模块只负责**装配**（纯配置 + 节点构建），不启动网络循环，因此可以被单测直接调用。

真实签名（实测 nautilus_trader 2.0.0rc6，见 .herd-dispatch/jobs/live-node/report.md）::

    LiveNodeBuilder.from_config(name, config=None, *, data_factories=None, exec_factories=None)
    LiveNodeBuilder.add_data_client(name, factory, config, routing=None)
    LiveNodeBuilder.add_exec_client(name, factory, config, routing=None)
    LiveNodeBuilder.add_simulated_exec_client(name, factory, config)
    LiveNodeBuilder.build() -> LiveNode
    LiveNode.add_strategy(strategy)            # 策略注册入口（已实测）
    LiveNode.add_actor(actor)

安全约束（CONTRACT §6）：
- ``dry_run=True`` 时**不读取任何私钥**（连 ``os.environ`` 里的密钥都不取），
  执行端一律用 ``add_simulated_exec_client``（沙盒），不可能发出真实订单；
- ``dry_run=False`` 时只从环境变量读密钥，缺密钥直接抛 :class:`MissingCredentials`，
  在任何网络连接之前失败。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional

from nautilus_trader.adapters.hyperliquid import (
    HyperliquidDataClientConfig,
    HyperliquidDataClientFactory,
    HyperliquidEnvironment,
    HyperliquidExecutionClientConfig,
    HyperliquidExecutionClientFactory,
)
from nautilus_trader.adapters.lighter import (
    LighterDataClientConfig,
    LighterDataClientFactory,
    LighterDeployment,
    LighterEnvironment,
    LighterExecutionClientConfig,
    LighterExecutionClientFactory,
)
from nautilus_trader.adapters.sandbox import (
    SandboxExecutionClientConfig,
    SandboxExecutionClientFactory,
)
from nautilus_trader.common import DataActor
from nautilus_trader.execution import MakerTakerFeeModel
from nautilus_trader.live import LiveNode, LiveNodeBuilder, LiveNodeConfig
from nautilus_trader.model import AccountId, Currency, InstrumentId, Money, Venue

from .pair_spec import load_pair
from .strategy import PairHedgeConfig, PairHedgeStrategy

__all__ = [
    "MissingCredentials",
    "LegPlan",
    "LivePlan",
    "SubscriptionPlan",
    "NodeBundle",
    "load_live_plan",
    "build_client_specs",
    "build_node",
    "scan_secret_fields",
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 场所 → 适配器
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

VENUE_HYPERLIQUID = "HYPERLIQUID"
VENUE_LIGHTER = "LIGHTER"
SUPPORTED_VENUES = (VENUE_HYPERLIQUID, VENUE_LIGHTER)

#: 触发实盘执行时每个场所必须提供的环境变量（dry-run 下完全不看）。
REQUIRED_ENV = {
    VENUE_HYPERLIQUID: ("HL_PRIVATE_KEY",),
    VENUE_LIGHTER: ("LIGHTER_PRIVATE_KEY",),
}

#: 凭据字段名——装配层自检用（断言这些字段在 dry-run 下全为空）。
SECRET_FIELD_NAMES = (
    "private_key",
    "api_key",
    "secret",
    "api_secret",
    "passphrase",
)


class MissingCredentials(RuntimeError):
    """实盘模式缺少必需的环境变量凭据。

    属性:
        venue: 缺凭据的场所名。
        missing: 缺失的环境变量名列表。
    """

    def __init__(self, venue: str, missing: list[str]) -> None:
        self.venue = venue
        self.missing = list(missing)
        super().__init__(
            f"missing credentials for venue {venue}: {', '.join(self.missing)}"
        )

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """返回结构化错误载荷（供 CLI 打印 JSON）。"""
        return {
            "error": "missing_credentials",
            "venue": self.venue,
            "missing": list(self.missing),
            "hint": "set the listed environment variables before starting a live node",
        }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 配置模型
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LegPlan:
    """一条腿的装配计划。

    Attributes:
        role: ``"leader"``（被动挂单腿）或 ``"follower"``（IOC 对冲腿）。
        venue: 场所名（``HYPERLIQUID`` / ``LIGHTER``）。
        instrument_id: nautilus 风格的 instrument id。
        direction: 开仓方向（``"BUY"`` / ``"SELL"``）。
        max_qty: 单腿数量上限（Decimal）。
    """

    role: str
    venue: str
    instrument_id: str
    direction: str
    max_qty: Decimal
    maker_fee_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0")
    taker_fee_bps: Decimal = Decimal("0")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SubscriptionPlan:
    """一条 L2 订阅计划。"""

    instrument_id: str
    book_type: str
    role: str
    venue: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LivePlan:
    """整个 pair 的装配计划（纯数据，无网络、无 IO）。"""

    name: str
    leader: LegPlan
    follower: LegPlan
    ratio: Decimal
    sigma_1m_bps: Decimal
    max_leg_usd: Decimal
    dry_run: bool
    state_dir: str
    book_max_age_ms: int
    subscriptions: tuple[SubscriptionPlan, ...] = field(default=())

    @property
    def instrument_ids(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """两腿 instrument id（订阅顺序：leader 在前）。"""
        return tuple(sub.instrument_id for sub in self.subscriptions)

    @property
    def venues(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """需要连接执行端的场所（按出现顺序去重）。"""
        seen: list[str] = []
        for sub in self.subscriptions:
            if sub.venue not in seen:
                seen.append(sub.venue)
        return tuple(seen)


def _leg_direction(raw: dict[str, Any], role: str, default: str) -> str:
    """从 JSON 取方向，缺省按 CONTRACT §6 的主被动约定给默认值。"""
    value = str(raw.get("direction", default)).upper()
    if value not in ("BUY", "SELL"):
        raise ValueError(f"{role}.direction must be BUY or SELL (got {value!r})")
    return value


def _leg_qty(raw: dict[str, Any], role: str, default: str) -> Decimal:
    """从 JSON 取数量上限（字符串 / 数字皆可，禁止 float）。"""
    value = raw.get("max_qty", default)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        raise ValueError(f"{role}.max_qty must not be a float (got {value!r})")
    return Decimal(str(value))


def load_live_plan(path: str | Path) -> LivePlan:
    """读取 pair 配置并生成 :class:`LivePlan`。

    支持两种 JSON 布局：

    **A. 仓库既有的 pair-spec 布局**（``configs/openai_entropy_lighter.json`` 等）——
    ``leader`` / ``follower`` 段由 :func:`nt_pairs.pair_spec.load_pair` 校验
    （Decimal 精确、缺字段即报错）；实盘开关放在顶层 ``live`` 段：

    .. code-block:: json

        {
          "name": "...",
          "leader": {...}, "follower": {...},
          "ratio": "1", "unit_evidence": "...", "sigma_1m_bps": "15", "max_leg_usd": "500",
          "live": {
            "dry_run": true,
            "state_dir": "state",
            "book_max_age_ms": 1000,
            "leader_direction": "BUY",
            "follower_direction": "SELL",
            "max_leg_qty": "0.05"
          }
        }

    **B. 腿 A/B 布局**（任务书指定的 ``configs/pair.json``）：

    .. code-block:: json

        {
          "name": "...",
          "dry_run": true,
          "leg_a": {"instrument_id": "...", "venue": "HYPERLIQUID",
                    "direction": "BUY", "max_qty": "0.05"},
          "leg_b": {"instrument_id": "...", "venue": "LIGHTER",
                    "direction": "SELL", "max_qty": "0.05"},
          "ratio": "1", "sigma_1m_bps": "15", "max_leg_usd": "500"
        }
    """
    p = Path(path)
    raw = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{p.name}: top level must be a JSON object")

    live_raw = raw.get("live", {}) or {}
    if not isinstance(live_raw, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{p.name}: 'live' must be a JSON object")

    if "leg_a" in raw or "leg_b" in raw:
        return _plan_from_legs(p, raw, live_raw)
    return _plan_from_pair_spec(p, raw, live_raw)


def _plan_from_pair_spec(
    p: Path,
    raw: dict[str, Any],
    live_raw: dict[str, Any],
) -> LivePlan:
    """由仓库既有 pair-spec 布局生成计划。"""
    spec = load_pair(p)

    dry_run = bool(live_raw.get("dry_run", True))
    state_dir = str(live_raw.get("state_dir", "state"))
    book_max_age_ms = int(live_raw.get("book_max_age_ms", 1000))
    max_qty = _leg_qty(live_raw, "live", "0.05")
    leader_direction = _leg_direction(live_raw, "leader", "BUY")
    follower_direction = _leg_direction(live_raw, "follower", "SELL")

    leader = LegPlan(
        role="leader",
        venue=spec.leader.venue.upper(),
        instrument_id=spec.leader.instrument_id,
        direction=leader_direction,
        max_qty=max_qty,
        maker_fee_bps=spec.leader.maker_fee_bps,
        taker_fee_bps=spec.leader.taker_fee_bps,
    )
    follower = LegPlan(
        role="follower",
        venue=spec.follower.venue.upper(),
        instrument_id=spec.follower.instrument_id,
        direction=follower_direction,
        max_qty=max_qty,
        maker_fee_bps=spec.follower.maker_fee_bps,
        taker_fee_bps=spec.follower.taker_fee_bps,
    )
    return _finalize_plan(
        p=p,
        name=spec.name,
        leader=leader,
        follower=follower,
        ratio=spec.ratio,
        sigma_1m_bps=spec.sigma_1m_bps,
        max_leg_usd=spec.max_leg_usd,
        dry_run=dry_run,
        state_dir=state_dir,
        book_max_age_ms=book_max_age_ms,
    )


def _plan_from_legs(
    p: Path,
    raw: dict[str, Any],
    live_raw: dict[str, Any],
) -> LivePlan:
    """由腿 A/B 布局生成计划。"""
    leg_a = raw.get("leg_a") or {}
    leg_b = raw.get("leg_b") or {}
    if not isinstance(leg_a, dict) or not isinstance(leg_b, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{p.name}: 'leg_a' and 'leg_b' must be JSON objects")
    for key in ("instrument_id", "venue"):
        for leg_name, leg in (("leg_a", leg_a), ("leg_b", leg_b)):
            if not leg.get(key):
                raise ValueError(f"{p.name}: {leg_name}.{key} is required")

    dry_run = bool(raw.get("dry_run", live_raw.get("dry_run", True)))
    state_dir = str(raw.get("state_dir", live_raw.get("state_dir", "state")))
    book_max_age_ms = int(raw.get("book_max_age_ms", live_raw.get("book_max_age_ms", 1000)))
    max_qty = _leg_qty(raw.get("live", {}) or live_raw, "live", "0.05")

    leader = LegPlan(
        role="leader",
        venue=str(leg_a["venue"]).upper(),
        instrument_id=str(leg_a["instrument_id"]),
        direction=_leg_direction(leg_a, "leg_a", "BUY"),
        max_qty=_leg_qty(leg_a, "leg_a", str(max_qty)),
    )
    follower = LegPlan(
        role="follower",
        venue=str(leg_b["venue"]).upper(),
        instrument_id=str(leg_b["instrument_id"]),
        direction=_leg_direction(leg_b, "leg_b", "SELL"),
        max_qty=_leg_qty(leg_b, "leg_b", str(max_qty)),
    )
    return _finalize_plan(
        p=p,
        name=str(raw.get("name", p.stem)),
        leader=leader,
        follower=follower,
        ratio=Decimal(str(raw.get("ratio", "1"))),
        sigma_1m_bps=Decimal(str(raw.get("sigma_1m_bps", "12.86"))),
        max_leg_usd=Decimal(str(raw.get("max_leg_usd", "500"))),
        dry_run=dry_run,
        state_dir=state_dir,
        book_max_age_ms=book_max_age_ms,
    )


def _finalize_plan(
    *,
    p: Path,
    name: str,
    leader: LegPlan,
    follower: LegPlan,
    ratio: Decimal,
    sigma_1m_bps: Decimal,
    max_leg_usd: Decimal,
    dry_run: bool,
    state_dir: str,
    book_max_age_ms: int,
) -> LivePlan:
    """校验场所并生成订阅列表。"""
    for leg in (leader, follower):
        if leg.venue not in SUPPORTED_VENUES:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{p.name}: unsupported venue {leg.venue!r} "
                f"(supported: {', '.join(SUPPORTED_VENUES)})"
            )
        if leg.max_qty <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{p.name}: {leg.role}.max_qty must be > 0")

    subscriptions = (
        SubscriptionPlan(leader.instrument_id, "L2_MBP", leader.role, leader.venue),
        SubscriptionPlan(follower.instrument_id, "L2_MBP", follower.role, follower.venue),
    )
    return LivePlan(
        name=name,
        leader=leader,
        follower=follower,
        ratio=ratio,
        sigma_1m_bps=sigma_1m_bps,
        max_leg_usd=max_leg_usd,
        dry_run=dry_run,
        state_dir=state_dir,
        book_max_age_ms=book_max_age_ms,
        subscriptions=subscriptions,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 客户端配置装配
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ClientSpec:
    """一个待注册客户端的装配描述。"""

    name: str
    kind: str  # "data" | "exec" | "sim_exec"
    factory: Any
    config: Any
    venue: str


def _hyperliquid_data_config(environment: HyperliquidEnvironment) -> HyperliquidDataClientConfig:
    return HyperliquidDataClientConfig(environment=environment)


def _lighter_data_config(environment: LighterEnvironment) -> LighterDataClientConfig:
    return LighterDataClientConfig(
        environment=environment,
        deployment=LighterDeployment.LIGHTER,
    )


def _sandbox_exec_config(venue: str, leg: LegPlan) -> SandboxExecutionClientConfig:
    """沙盒执行端（dry-run 唯一允许的执行入口）。

    2.0 要求显式给 fee_model（连零费率模型也必须显式给），否则
    ``SandboxExecutionClientConfig`` 直接抛 ``RuntimeError``。
    费率取自该腿配置的 maker/taker bps。
    """
    usd = Currency.from_str("USD")
    maker_rate = Decimal(leg.maker_fee_bps) / Decimal(10_000)
    taker_rate = Decimal(leg.taker_fee_bps) / Decimal(10_000)
    return SandboxExecutionClientConfig(
        venue=Venue(venue),
        starting_balances=[Money(1_000_000, usd)],
        base_currency=usd,
        fee_model=MakerTakerFeeModel(maker_rate=maker_rate, taker_rate=taker_rate),
    )


def _hyperliquid_exec_config(environment: HyperliquidEnvironment) -> HyperliquidExecutionClientConfig:
    """实盘 HL 执行端——只在这里读取私钥。"""
    private_key = os.environ.get("HL_PRIVATE_KEY")
    account_address = os.environ.get("HL_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS")
    if not private_key:
        raise MissingCredentials(VENUE_HYPERLIQUID, ["HL_PRIVATE_KEY"])
    return HyperliquidExecutionClientConfig(
        account_address=account_address,
        private_key=private_key,
        environment=environment,
    )


def _lighter_exec_config(environment: LighterEnvironment) -> LighterExecutionClientConfig:
    """实盘 Lighter 执行端——只在这里读取私钥。"""
    private_key = os.environ.get("LIGHTER_PRIVATE_KEY")
    account_index = os.environ.get("LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX")
    if not private_key:
        raise MissingCredentials(VENUE_LIGHTER, ["LIGHTER_PRIVATE_KEY"])
    return LighterExecutionClientConfig(
        account_id=AccountId(os.environ.get("LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_ID", "LIGHTER-001")),
        account_index=int(account_index) if account_index else None,
        api_key_index=int(os.environ.get("LIGHTER_API_KEY_INDEX", "4")),
        private_key=private_key,
        environment=environment,
        deployment=LighterDeployment.LIGHTER,
    )


def _leg_for_venue(plan: LivePlan, venue: str) -> LegPlan:
    """按场所取腿（同一 pair 两腿不同场所）。"""
    for leg in (plan.leader, plan.follower):
        if leg.venue == venue:
            return leg
    raise ValueError(f"no leg configured for venue {venue!r}")


def build_client_specs(
    plan: LivePlan,
    *,
    dry_run: Optional[bool] = None,
    environment: str = "mainnet",
) -> list[ClientSpec]:
    """生成客户端装配列表（不建立网络连接）。

    Args:
        plan: :class:`LivePlan`。
        dry_run: 覆盖 ``plan.dry_run``；``True`` 时不读取任何凭据，执行端用沙盒。
        environment: ``"mainnet"`` 或 ``"testnet"``。

    Returns:
        :class:`ClientSpec` 列表（先数据端、后执行端）。
    """
    use_dry_run = plan.dry_run if dry_run is None else bool(dry_run)
    hl_env = (
        HyperliquidEnvironment.MAINNET
        if environment == "mainnet"
        else HyperliquidEnvironment.TESTNET
    )
    lt_env = (
        LighterEnvironment.MAINNET
        if environment == "mainnet"
        else LighterEnvironment.TESTNET
    )

    specs: list[ClientSpec] = []
    for venue in plan.venues:
        if venue == VENUE_HYPERLIQUID:
            specs.append(
                ClientSpec(
                    name="hyperliquid",
                    kind="data",
                    factory=HyperliquidDataClientFactory(),
                    config=_hyperliquid_data_config(hl_env),
                    venue=venue,
                )
            )
        elif venue == VENUE_LIGHTER:
            specs.append(
                ClientSpec(
                    name="lighter",
                    kind="data",
                    factory=LighterDataClientFactory(),
                    config=_lighter_data_config(lt_env),
                    venue=venue,
                )
            )
        else:  # pragma: no cover - load_live_plan 已校验
            raise ValueError(f"unsupported venue {venue!r}")

    for venue in plan.venues:
        if use_dry_run:
            specs.append(
                ClientSpec(
                    name=f"{venue.lower()}-sim",
                    kind="sim_exec",
                    factory=SandboxExecutionClientFactory(),
                    config=_sandbox_exec_config(venue, _leg_for_venue(plan, venue)),
                    venue=venue,
                )
            )
            continue
        if venue == VENUE_HYPERLIQUID:
            specs.append(
                ClientSpec(
                    name="hyperliquid",
                    kind="exec",
                    factory=HyperliquidExecutionClientFactory(),
                    config=_hyperliquid_exec_config(hl_env),
                    venue=venue,
                )
            )
        elif venue == VENUE_LIGHTER:
            specs.append(
                ClientSpec(
                    name="lighter",
                    kind="exec",
                    factory=LighterExecutionClientFactory(),
                    config=_lighter_exec_config(lt_env),
                    venue=venue,
                )
            )
    return specs


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 心跳 actor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class PairHeartbeatActor(DataActor):
    """每 5 秒打一条心跳，并汇报两腿的订阅状态。

    心跳字段：盘口时间戳、两腿 mid、基差（bps）、residual、naked_age（秒）。

    数据流只订阅一次：由 :class:`~nt_pairs.strategy.PairHedgeStrategy` 在
    ``on_start`` 里订阅两腿 L2_MBP。本 actor **不重复订阅**，改为读策略维护的
    ``book_ts``（收到过 deltas 即视为订阅成功）以及 cache 里的盘口，
    避免同一 instrument 出现两条数据流。
    """

    def __new__(cls, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        # 2.0 的 DataActor.__new__ 只接受 0~1 个位置参数，自定义构造参数需在此吞掉。
        return super().__new__(cls)

    def __init__(self, strategy: PairHedgeStrategy, plan: LivePlan) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._strategy = strategy
        self._plan = plan
        self._ticks = 0

    # -- 生命周期 ---------------------------------------------------------
    def on_start(self) -> None:
        self.clock.set_timer(
            name="heartbeat",
            interval=timedelta(seconds=5),
            callback=self._on_heartbeat,
        )
        self.log.info(
            f"heartbeat actor started instruments={list(self._plan.instrument_ids)}"
        )

    def on_stop(self) -> None:
        self.log.info("heartbeat actor stopped")

    # -- 心跳 -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_heartbeat(self, event: Any = None) -> None:
        self._ticks += 1
        now = self.clock.timestamp_ns() / 1e9
        book_ts = dict(getattr(self._strategy, "book_ts", {}) or {})
        mids: dict[str, Optional[float]] = {}
        for sub in self._plan.subscriptions:
            mids[sub.instrument_id] = self._mid(sub.instrument_id)
        leader_mid = mids.get(self._plan.leader.instrument_id)
        follower_mid = mids.get(self._plan.follower.instrument_id)
        basis_bps: Optional[float] = None
        if leader_mid and follower_mid and leader_mid > 0:
            basis_bps = (follower_mid / leader_mid - 1.0) * 1e4
        residual = self._strategy.ledger.residual()
        naked_since = getattr(self._strategy, "naked_since", None)
        naked_age = None if naked_since is None else round(now - float(naked_since), 3)
        payload = {
            "kind": "heartbeat",
            "tick": self._ticks,
            "ts_event": book_ts,
            "mid": mids,
            "basis_bps": basis_bps,
            "residual": str(residual),
            "naked_age_s": naked_age,
            "subscribed": self.subscription_status(),
        }
        self.log.info(json.dumps(payload, default=str))

    def _mid(self, instrument_id: str) -> Optional[float]:
        try:
            book = self.cache.order_book(InstrumentId.from_str(instrument_id))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - cache 尚未有该 book
            return None
        if book is None:
            return None
        bid, ask = book.best_bid_price(), book.best_ask_price()
        if not bid or not ask:
            return None
        return float(bid + ask) / 2.0

    def subscription_status(self) -> dict[str, bool]:
        """每条腿的订阅状态（策略收到过该腿的 deltas 即为 True）。"""
        book_ts = getattr(self._strategy, "book_ts", {}) or {}
        return {
            sub.instrument_id: str(sub.instrument_id) in book_ts
            for sub in self._plan.subscriptions
        }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 节点装配
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class NodeBundle:
    """构建好的节点及其附属对象。"""

    node: LiveNode
    plan: LivePlan
    strategy: PairHedgeStrategy
    heartbeat: PairHeartbeatActor
    client_specs: list[ClientSpec]


def build_node(
    plan: LivePlan,
    *,
    dry_run: Optional[bool] = None,
    environment: str = "mainnet",
    node_name: Optional[str] = None,
) -> NodeBundle:
    """按计划组装 ``LiveNode``（不启动网络循环）。

    策略注册入口为 ``LiveNode.add_strategy(instance)``（实测 2.0.0rc6：
    ``LiveNodeConfig`` **没有** strategies 字段，``LiveNodeBuilder`` 也没有
    ``with_strategy``；只有 node 级别的 ``add_strategy`` /
    ``add_strategy_from_config`` / ``add_builtin_strategy``）。
    """
    use_dry_run = plan.dry_run if dry_run is None else bool(dry_run)
    specs = build_client_specs(plan, dry_run=use_dry_run, environment=environment)

    config = LiveNodeConfig(
        environment=None,
        load_state=False,
        save_state=False,
        shutdown_on_error=True,
    )
    builder = LiveNodeBuilder.from_config(node_name or plan.name, config)
    for spec in specs:
        if spec.kind == "data":
            builder.add_data_client(spec.name, spec.factory, spec.config)
        elif spec.kind == "exec":
            builder.add_exec_client(spec.name, spec.factory, spec.config)
        else:
            builder.add_simulated_exec_client(spec.name, spec.factory, spec.config)

    node = builder.build()

    strategy_config = PairHedgeConfig(
        leader_id=plan.leader.instrument_id,
        follower_id=plan.follower.instrument_id,
        ratio=str(plan.ratio),
        sigma_1m_bps=str(plan.sigma_1m_bps),
        max_leg_qty=str(plan.leader.max_qty),
        book_max_age_ms=plan.book_max_age_ms,
        dry_run=use_dry_run,
        state_dir=plan.state_dir,
    )
    strategy = PairHedgeStrategy(strategy_config)
    node.add_strategy(strategy)

    heartbeat = PairHeartbeatActor(strategy, plan)
    node.add_actor(heartbeat)

    return NodeBundle(
        node=node,
        plan=plan,
        strategy=strategy,
        heartbeat=heartbeat,
        client_specs=specs,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 凭据自检
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _iter_config_objects(obj: Any, depth: int = 0):
    """递归遍历配置对象（属性型 pyo3 类）。"""
    if obj is None or depth > 3:
        return
    yield obj
    for name in dir(obj):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(obj, name)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, Decimal)):
            continue
        if hasattr(value, "__dict__") or type(value).__module__.startswith("nautilus_trader"):
            yield from _iter_config_objects(value, depth + 1)


def scan_secret_fields(bundle: NodeBundle) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """扫描装配结果里的凭据字段。

    Returns:
        ``{"populated": [...], "fields": {field: value}}``——``populated`` 列出
        **有值**的凭据字段；dry-run 下必须为空。
    """
    populated: list[str] = []
    fields: dict[str, Any] = {}
    targets: list[Any] = [bundle.node]
    targets.extend(spec.config for spec in bundle.client_specs)
    for obj in targets:
        for candidate in _iter_config_objects(obj):
            for field_name in SECRET_FIELD_NAMES:
                if not hasattr(candidate, field_name):
                    continue
                value = getattr(candidate, field_name)
                fields.setdefault(field_name, value)
                if value:
                    populated.append(f"{type(candidate).__name__}.{field_name}")
    return {"populated": populated, "fields": fields}

用法::

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

import json

import sys

from typing import Any, Optional

from nautilus_trader.live import LiveNode

from .live_node import (

MissingCredentials,

NodeBundle,

build_node,

load_live_plan,

scan_secret_fields,

)

EXIT_OK = 0

EXIT_CONFIG = 2

EXIT_BUILD = 3

EXIT_RUNTIME = 4

def _fail(payload: dict[str, Any], code: int) -> int:

"""打印结构化错误并返回退出码。"""

print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, default=str), file=sys.stderr)

return code

def _summary(bundle: NodeBundle) -> dict[str, Any]:

"""启动摘要（不含任何凭据）。"""

plan = bundle.plan

return {

"pair": plan.name,

"dry_run": plan.dry_run,

"leader": {

"instrument_id": plan.leader.instrument_id,

"venue": plan.leader.venue,

"direction": plan.leader.direction,

"max_qty": str(plan.leader.max_qty),

},

"follower": {

"instrument_id": plan.follower.instrument_id,

"venue": plan.follower.venue,

"direction": plan.follower.direction,

"max_qty": str(plan.follower.max_qty),

},

"subscriptions": [

{

"instrument_id": sub.instrument_id,

"book_type": sub.book_type,

"role": sub.role,

"venue": sub.venue,

}

for sub in plan.subscriptions

],

"clients": [

{

"name": spec.name,

"kind": spec.kind,

"venue": spec.venue,

"config": repr(spec.config),

}

for spec in bundle.client_specs

],

}

def _run(node: LiveNode, max_secs: float) -> int:

"""跑节点；`max_secs > 0` 时到点优雅停机。

2.0 的 `LiveNode.run() 是阻塞式同步入口，handle().stop()` 触发优雅关闭

（实测关闭流程约 10s：residual events 10s + client disconnects）。

"""

import threading

import time

handle = node.handle()

timer: Optional[threading.Timer] = None

if max_secs > 0:

timer = threading.Timer(max_secs, handle.stop)

timer.daemon = True

timer.start()

try:

node.run()

except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001 - 顶层错误统一结构化

return _fail(

{

"error": "node_run_failed",

"exception": type(exc).__name__,

"detail": str(exc),

"hint": "check network reachability of the venue endpoints and the pair config",

},

EXIT_RUNTIME,

)

finally:

if timer is not None:

timer.cancel()

return EXIT_OK

def main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> int:

"""CLI 主函数。"""

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="nt_pairs.live_runner")

parser.add_argument("--config", required=True, help="pair 配置 JSON 路径")

parser.add_argument(

"--dry-run",

action="store_true",

help="只读行情 + 沙盒执行端；不读私钥、不发真实订单",

)

parser.add_argument(

"--environment",

default="mainnet",

choices=("mainnet", "testnet"),

help="适配器环境（默认 mainnet）",

)

parser.add_argument(

"--max-secs",

type=float,

default=60.0,

help="运行时长上限（秒）；0 表示一直跑到 Ctrl-C。默认 60",

)

args = parser.parse_args(argv)

# -- 配置 ---------------------------------------------------------------

try:

plan = load_live_plan(args.config)

except FileNotFoundError:

return _fail(

{

"error": "config_not_found",

"path": args.config,

"hint": "pass an existing pair config, e.g. configs/openai_entropy_lighter.json",

},

EXIT_CONFIG,

)

except ValueError as exc:

return _fail(

{"error": "invalid_config", "path": args.config, "detail": str(exc)},

EXIT_CONFIG,

)

dry_run = bool(args.dry_run) or plan.dry_run

# -- 装配 ---------------------------------------------------------------

try:

bundle = build_node(

plan,

dry_run=dry_run,

environment=args.environment,

)

except MissingCredentials as exc:

return _fail(exc.as_dict(), EXIT_BUILD)

except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001

return _fail(

{

"error": "node_build_failed",

"exception": type(exc).__name__,

"detail": str(exc),

},

EXIT_BUILD,

)

secrets = scan_secret_fields(bundle)

if dry_run and secrets["populated"]:

return _fail(

{

"error": "secret_leak_in_dry_run",

"populated": secrets["populated"],

"hint": "dry-run must not carry any credential",

},

EXIT_BUILD,

)

print(json.dumps(_summary(bundle), indent=2, default=str))

print(

json.dumps(

{

"event": "node_starting",

"dry_run": dry_run,

"instruments": list(plan.instrument_ids),

"credentials_loaded": bool(secrets["populated"]),

}

),

flush=True,

)

return _run(bundle.node, args.max_secs)

if __name__ == "__main__":

raise SystemExit(main())

"""实盘节点入口。

用法::

    python -m nt_pairs.live_runner --config configs/pair.json [--dry-run]

行为约定：
- ``--dry-run``：**不读取任何私钥**，执行端用沙盒（``add_simulated_exec_client``），
  策略自身的 ``dry_run`` 也会置位，因此不可能发出真实订单；
- 实盘（非 dry-run）：从环境变量读凭据，缺什么就打印结构化 JSON 错误并以非 0 退出，
  在任何网络连接之前失败；
- 所有错误都以 JSON（``error`` / ``hint`` 字段）打到 stderr，便于 VPS 上被监控采集。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from typing import Any, Optional

from nautilus_trader.live import LiveNode

from .live_node import (
    MissingCredentials,
    NodeBundle,
    build_node,
    load_live_plan,
    scan_secret_fields,
)

EXIT_OK = 0
EXIT_CONFIG = 2
EXIT_BUILD = 3
EXIT_RUNTIME = 4


def _fail(payload: dict[str, Any], code: int) -> int:
    """打印结构化错误并返回退出码。"""
    print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, default=str), file=sys.stderr)
    return code


def _summary(bundle: NodeBundle) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """启动摘要（不含任何凭据）。"""
    plan = bundle.plan
    return {
        "pair": plan.name,
        "dry_run": plan.dry_run,
        "leader": {
            "instrument_id": plan.leader.instrument_id,
            "venue": plan.leader.venue,
            "direction": plan.leader.direction,
            "max_qty": str(plan.leader.max_qty),
        },
        "follower": {
            "instrument_id": plan.follower.instrument_id,
            "venue": plan.follower.venue,
            "direction": plan.follower.direction,
            "max_qty": str(plan.follower.max_qty),
        },
        "subscriptions": [
            {
                "instrument_id": sub.instrument_id,
                "book_type": sub.book_type,
                "role": sub.role,
                "venue": sub.venue,
            }
            for sub in plan.subscriptions
        ],
        "clients": [
            {
                "name": spec.name,
                "kind": spec.kind,
                "venue": spec.venue,
                "config": repr(spec.config),
            }
            for spec in bundle.client_specs
        ],
    }


def _run(node: LiveNode, max_secs: float) -> int:
    """跑节点；``max_secs > 0`` 时到点优雅停机。

    2.0 的 ``LiveNode.run()`` 是阻塞式同步入口，``handle().stop()`` 触发优雅关闭
    （实测关闭流程约 10s：residual events 10s + client disconnects）。
    """
    import threading
    import time

    handle = node.handle()
    timer: Optional[threading.Timer] = None
    if max_secs > 0:
        timer = threading.Timer(max_secs, handle.stop)
        timer.daemon = True
        timer.start()
    try:
        node.run()
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 顶层错误统一结构化
        return _fail(
            {
                "error": "node_run_failed",
                "exception": type(exc).__name__,
                "detail": str(exc),
                "hint": "check network reachability of the venue endpoints and the pair config",
            },
            EXIT_RUNTIME,
        )
    finally:
        if timer is not None:
            timer.cancel()
    return EXIT_OK


def main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> int:
    """CLI 主函数。"""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="nt_pairs.live_runner")
    parser.add_argument("--config", required=True, help="pair 配置 JSON 路径")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="只读行情 + 沙盒执行端；不读私钥、不发真实订单",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--environment",
        default="mainnet",
        choices=("mainnet", "testnet"),
        help="适配器环境（默认 mainnet）",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--max-secs",
        type=float,
        default=60.0,
        help="运行时长上限（秒）；0 表示一直跑到 Ctrl-C。默认 60",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    # -- 配置 ---------------------------------------------------------------
    try:
        plan = load_live_plan(args.config)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return _fail(
            {
                "error": "config_not_found",
                "path": args.config,
                "hint": "pass an existing pair config, e.g. configs/openai_entropy_lighter.json",
            },
            EXIT_CONFIG,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        return _fail(
            {"error": "invalid_config", "path": args.config, "detail": str(exc)},
            EXIT_CONFIG,
        )

    dry_run = bool(args.dry_run) or plan.dry_run

    # -- 装配 ---------------------------------------------------------------
    try:
        bundle = build_node(
            plan,
            dry_run=dry_run,
            environment=args.environment,
        )
    except MissingCredentials as exc:
        return _fail(exc.as_dict(), EXIT_BUILD)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return _fail(
            {
                "error": "node_build_failed",
                "exception": type(exc).__name__,
                "detail": str(exc),
            },
            EXIT_BUILD,
        )

    secrets = scan_secret_fields(bundle)
    if dry_run and secrets["populated"]:
        return _fail(
            {
                "error": "secret_leak_in_dry_run",
                "populated": secrets["populated"],
                "hint": "dry-run must not carry any credential",
            },
            EXIT_BUILD,
        )

    print(json.dumps(_summary(bundle), indent=2, default=str))
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "event": "node_starting",
                "dry_run": dry_run,
                "instruments": list(plan.instrument_ids),
                "credentials_loaded": bool(secrets["populated"]),
            }
        ),
        flush=True,
    )

    return _run(bundle.node, args.max_secs)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
